round.prompt:
Welcome to DJ Selection Assistant. This Agent Skill helps you build a DJ set. You will confirm your request in two rounds and receive AI track recommendations. Fill-in rules:

1. You can copy from an example, fill freely, or leave blank
2. Leaving a field blank means the AI will judge the answer intelligently

[Round 1: Essentials]

Scene:
“Performance setting. Examples: `bar` / `club` / `wedding` / `art exhibition`”
Target country / region:
“Examples: `Mainland China` / `Taiwan` / `Hong Kong` / `Japan` / `international English-language market`”
Core sound direction:
“Reference artist, track, and genre. Example: `Tears` by `Skrillex`, `modern UK Bass` genre”
Track count or set duration:
“Examples: `20 tracks` / `60 minutes`”
Output version:
“`Fast`: quick playlist output; quality may be lower”
“`Brief`: one combined playlist only”
“`Rich`: separate style, scene, familiarity/discovery views, followed by a final combined playlist”
Other constraints:
“Examples: `avoid overplayed tracks`, `no vocals`, `Remix only`; optional”
